subject: Post-call: Security & compliance follow-up (SOC 2, pen test, vuln process)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@fintechco.com>, FintechCo Security <security@fintechco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T14:23:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Security & compliance follow-up (SOC 2, pen test, vuln process)

Hi Alex / FintechCo security team —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

1) SOC 2 / compliance:
- You asked about our SOC 2 status: we completed SOC 2 Type II for Security in Q4 2025; the report is available for NDA-only sharing.
- If you'd like, I can initiate the secure share of the SOC 2 report once your security team confirms the contact for the NDA.

2) Pen test & vulnerability disclosures:
- You mentioned needing the most recent external penetration test report. We run annual external pen tests and quarterly internal vulnerability scans.
- Next steps: we can provide a redacted summary of the last external pen test and our vulnerability management policy now; full report shared under your standard non-disclosure / MSA terms.

3) Vendor security questionnaire (VSQ):
- If you prefer we can start a VSQ (you can send the doc or we can start on your portal).

4) Operational details (what Rishi will follow up on):
- Typical scanning cadence: automated authenticated scans weekly, unauthenticated scans daily for edge assets, and quarterly external pentests with remediation SLAs.
- SLA for vuln remediation tiers: Critical = 7 days, High = 30 days, Medium = 90 days, Low = tracked.

Action items: 
- Alex: confirm NDA contact (name + email) so we can share SOC 2 and the pen test summary.
- Security team: let me know if you prefer we start the VSQ in DocuSign/OneTrust or share a spreadsheet.
- Rishi: I'll hand this over to you to provide the vuln process doc and redacted pen test summary.

I'll attach a short summary of our vulnerability process for your review.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0133

Attachment: Redwood_Vuln_Process.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: FintechCo Security <security@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-05-13T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security & compliance follow-up (SOC 2, pen test, vuln process)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear summary. A couple quick items from our side: 

1) NDA contact: security@fintechco.com (we have a standard mutual NDA; please share a link or upload to our secure portal).
2) Pen test report: we prefer a redacted executive summary up-front and the full report after NDA.
3) VSQ: we'll push our questionnaire (OneTrust) to your team; Rishi should get an invite.

One additional ask: can you confirm whether Redwood has any HIPAA-scoped controls for ePHI (even if we're not planning to store ePHI yet)? If so, share the relevant control mapping.

Thanks —
FintechCo Security Team

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-14T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security & compliance follow-up (SOC 2, pen test, vuln process)

Hi team — Rishi here from Security Ops. Following up with the items Marissa outlined and answers to your questions: 

- SOC 2: confirmed, we are SOC 2 Type II (Security) with the latest attestation dated 2025-11-20. We'll share the report after NDA.

- Pen test: attached is a redacted executive summary of our most recent external penetration test (March 2026) — it includes findings by severity and remediation status. Full report is available under NDA.

- HIPAA scope: we do not currently operate in a HIPAA-specific production environment and do not process ePHI by default. That said, our controls map aligns with relevant controls and we have procedures to enable HIPAA-scoped deployments (encryption at rest/in transit, access controls, logging, retention policies). If you'd like, we can provide a control mapping doc showing how our controls map to HIPAA/SOC 2.

- Vulnerability management (high level; full doc attached):
  * Scanning cadence: authenticated scans weekly, unauthenticated daily for public endpoints, dependency scanning per-commit in CI, quarterly external pen tests.
  * Triage workflow: automated ticket creation -> severity classification -> remediation owner assignment.
  * SLAs: Critical = 7 days, High = 30 days, Medium = 90 days, Low = tracked.
  * Disclosure: We disclose remediation timelines and status on a case-by-case basis with customers; critical vulnerabilities result in immediate customer notification.

Action: Marissa — I've attached the redacted pen test summary and the vulnerability process PDF. Alex / Security team — once you confirm NDA contact, I will share the SOC 2 and the full pen test report via our secure file share.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
